SympSIST 2023: Humanitarian Project Design Idea Competition
caption:
Proud to announce that Team Buet Brothers has emerged as the champion at SympSIST 2023: Humanitarian Project Design Idea Competition, held during the 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT) by IEEE Bangladesh Section! 🏆

Our project, Murdhwani - the Bangla Sign Language interpreter, was developed to facilitate workforce integration in Bangladesh through a user-friendly sign language interpretation system. This innovative solution transforms acoustic signals into text and images, enabling seamless communication between sign and non-sign language users.

The ICCIT, an esteemed series of computer science and information technology conferences hosted annually in Bangladesh since 1997, provided an excellent platform for showcasing our project. 

Grateful for the opportunity and looking forward to further advancements in making communication more inclusive! #ICCIT2023 #HumanitarianProject #SignLanguage #Innovation #TeamBuetBrothers #BanglaSignLanguage #InclusiveCommunication #TechnologyForGood #ProudMoment
